name: North Carolina Department of Natural and Cultural Resources

goals.title: Educational excellence and innovation
goals.citation: NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources Strategic Plan, p. 7
goals.description: Expand and advance educational excellence and innovation throughout DNCR's sites and programs and support workforce pathways for our fields of work.
objectives: Expand and advance educational excellence and innovation throughout DNCR's sites and programs and support workforce pathways for our fields of work.

goals.title: Access to natural and cultural resources
goals.citation: NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources Strategic Plan, p. 9

goals.title: Operational efficiency and customer service
goals.citation: NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources Strategic Plan, p. 11

objectives: Improve operational efficiencies, collaboration, and customer service across DNCR.

goals.title: Western NC recovery and climate resilience
goals.citation: NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources Strategic Plan, p. 12

objectives: Support Western North Carolina's recovery from Hurricane Helene and integrate climate resilience into DNCR's work.
